fundamental_objective: PROTECT — wildlife have sufficient core habitat
performance_measure: Protected land: today's protected areas are locked in (33% of the Alberta extent); the Y2Y-wide plans select 30% of the whole Y2Y region and place 9,351 km² of additions in Alberta (balanced plan; 3,056–13,685 km² across the 14 positions)
in_the_analysis: The budget is Y2Y-wide (30% of the region); Alberta's share of the additions is an outcome of the corridor-wide optimum, not a budget
metric: 9,351 km² of additions in Alberta (an outcome)

performance_measure: Climate refugia: refugial residence time (1 / backward climate velocity, floored at one cell width over the horizon), 2071–2100, two emission futures
source: AdaptWest 2023, CMIP6 backward climate velocity (8-GCM ensemble)
in_the_analysis: Climate-refugia theme: 20% of the objective in the balanced position; the two futures are separate value positions

source: Theobald et al., global human modification (gHM v3)
in_the_analysis: In every formulation at its baseline weight; it cannot move the answer — disclosed, not a driver

performance_measure: Mammal richness (species per km², area-of-habitat maps, all species)
source: Lumbierres et al., AOH species richness (mammals)
in_the_analysis: Biodiversity theme: 20% (balanced); the two layers weighted equally

performance_measure: Bird richness (species per km², area-of-habitat maps, all species)
source: Lumbierres et al., AOH species richness (birds)

performance_measure: Presence of 20 ecosystem functional groups across the Y2Y region (13 of them present in Alberta), curated under the input pre-screen (rule R0)
source: IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology, indicative maps (Keith et al. 2022)
in_the_analysis: A representation floor, not a weighted theme: rarity-scaled targets of 10–50% per class, rarity judged in the Y2Y region + 250 km

fundamental_objective: CONNECT — wildlife corridors connect core habitats
performance_measure: Habitat connectivity: transboundary omnidirectional current density, valued convexly (current squared) — pinch points count more than proportionally
source: Pither et al. 2023 / O'Brien et al. (transboundary extension)
in_the_analysis: Structural-connectivity theme: 20% (balanced); no security target — pinch points are places, not an amount (the R2 semantic gate)

performance_measure: Climate corridors: current-flow centrality across climate-analog classes
in_the_analysis: Climate-corridors theme: 20% (balanced); its own forward position (S2c)

performance_measure: Bear coexistence programs: active local and regional groups per census division or county (a bear-friendliness score is a candidate measure)
source: Y2Y Communities & Conservation, coexistence group tracking (July 2026)
in_the_analysis: Not a model input: reported beside each cluster as a reference statistic (the consequences tables' starred row)

fundamental_objective: ADDRESS CLIMATE CHANGE — keep carbon out of the air
in_the_analysis: Carbon theme: 20% (balanced); the two pools split by mass across the Y2Y region
Security target: 33% of the Y2Y-wide total (55% in the carbon-forward position); Alberta holds whatever share of it the corridor-wide plan takes here
metric: carbon share · soil · target 33% (55%) of the Y2Y total

in_the_analysis: Not flushed out for this analysis; tenure is reported after the fact (crown → protection track, private ranchland → OECM track), never optimized; the Y2Y-wide area budget stands in for cost
